name: Report Generation and Download
description: Navigate to a reporting section, select a report type, configure parameters, generate the report, and download it.
intent: Generate a configured report and download the output file

steps.context_hint: A dropdown, card, or list of available report types

steps.intent: Set the reporting period start date
steps.context_hint: A date input for the start of the reporting period

steps.intent: Set the reporting period end date
steps.context_hint: A date input for the end of the reporting period

steps.intent: Select the output format for the report
steps.context_hint: A dropdown or radio buttons for format like PDF, CSV, or Excel
A button labeled 'Generate', 'Run Report', or 'Create Report'
steps.verification: Report generation starts, progress indicator or spinner appears

steps.intent: Wait for the report to finish generating
steps.context_hint: Wait for the progress bar to complete or a 'Ready' status to appear
steps.verification: Report status shows as complete or a download link appears

steps.intent: Click the download button to save the generated report
steps.context_hint: A 'Download' button or link that appeared after generation completed
